LanguageData.ArchotechEyeInvisibilityDetection_Detect: Optional support for Alpha Animals' stalking-state hediff and graphics. Enabled by default when a supported Alpha Animals version is loaded. Does not remove camouflage, share targeting information or change the animal's normal targeting rules.
LanguageData.ArchotechEyeInvisibilityDetection_AlphaU: Alpha Animals stalking integration is unavailable: the mod is not loaded or its graphics API is unsupported.
LanguageData.ArchotechEyeInvisibilityDetection_Settin: Vanilla-system invisibility detection remains enabled independently. Range stays at 36 tiles with line of sight. Changes take effect at the next 60-game-tick cache refresh.
LanguageData.ArchotechEyeInvisibilityDetection_Diagno: The pawn has Alpha Animals' actual stalking-state hediff. The optional compatibility module can reveal it under the normal range and line-of-sight rules, without changing the game invisibility predicate.
The pawn has Alpha Animals' actual stalking-state hediff, but the optional detection setting is disabled. Native-system invisibility is still evaluated independently.
